title: News 10.29.2026
content: Study reveals distinct cellular and genetic differences in colorectal cancer in younger patients Researchers identified age-associated differences in tumor composition and gene activity, creating a foundation for investigating why colorectal cancer can be more aggressive in younger adults. By Mass General Brigham Communications October 29, 2026 Credit: Porter CBM. et al. Nature Medicine. DOI: 10.1038/s41591-026-04721-y Microscopy image of an early-onset colorectal tumor tissue shows different cell types by color (stromal cells in green, epithelial cells in pink).
